bugs.description: The 'ref' prop is not forwarded to SheetPrimitive.Content, preventing external components from programmatically accessing or interacting with the sheet's DOM element.
The open and close animation durations for the sheet are swapped, causing the sheet to close slower than it opens, which can lead to a disjointed user experience.
The SheetClose button is mispositioned by one unit on the right side due to an 'off-by-one' error in its 'right-3' class, causing a slight visual inconsistency.
